## Why ProGantt exists

It started as a developer's frustration: wanting one clear, honest picture of where my projects actually stood, and finding that every tool offering it was expensive, slow and painful to keep up to date. Feeding a full planning suite becomes a second job — by the time the plan is accurate, it is already stale.

So ProGantt does one thing. A real Gantt chart that is fast to build, fast to read, and scales from a weekend side project to a full roadmap. No onboarding project, no consultant, no afternoon of setup before you can sketch a timeline.

And because it speaks MCP, the AI that already governs your projects governs the plan too: your agent reads it, updates it and keeps it honest while you work, instead of you maintaining it by hand.
